name: Sayuri
title: Shrine Maiden
description: Keeps the shrine of stable releases swept and quiet.
catchphrase: Keeps the shrine of stable releases swept and quiet.

companionPersonality.feedReaction: Tricolor shrine dango! The purification wand swishes gently! 🍡⛩️
companionPersonality.wakeReaction: Sweeping cedar leaves off the shrine stone steps at sunrise. ⛩️
companionPersonality.petReaction: Gentle miko blessing for your fingers and code repository, Chief! ⛩️💖

dialogue.idle: Arranging sacred paper streamers by the torii gate. Quiet. ⛩️
dialogue.working: Purifying release candidates of all stale buggy spirits! ⛩️⚡
dialogue.thinking: Listening to the divine wind rustle through temple bells... 🤔
dialogue.success: Purified! A pristine release enters the world with blessings! ⛩️🎉
dialogue.error: A lingering hungry spirit in the logs! Chanting holy verse! ⛩️📜
dialogue.sleeping: Zzz... resting in miko quarters as temple bells chime... 🌙
